story: Emergency stabilization at an excluded provider

insurer_error.description: All expenses at a notified excluded provider

letter_deductions.deduction: All expenses at a notified excluded provider
letter_deductions.why: The prior provider notice names the facility as excluded. Emergency admission followed a serious accident on 10 Aug 2026. The attending note records stabilization on 12 Aug and suitability for transfer. The bill separates treatment up to stabilization from later charges at the same facility.
